answers.reasoning: persist's no-storage branch returns config(warnWrappedSet, get, api) early, wrapping only set with a console.warn, never touching api.setState
devtools' extension message switch calls setStateFromDevtools on RESET, ROLLBACK, JUMP_TO_STATE/JUMP_TO_ACTION, and IMPORT_STATE; COMMIT just re-inits the connection
default persist merge is a shallow {...currentState, ...persistedState} spread, so the old nested settings object fully replaces the new default and drops the added key
TS partial type-argument inference is all-or-nothing (TS#10571-style limitation); explicit T disables inference of the mutator list, so create<T>() curries to separate annotation from inference
createWithEqualityFn in zustand/traditional is the general custom-equality-function hook, built on the use-sync-external-store with-selector shim
